invariants.rationale: The result object is updated and returned by the method, so it should not be null upon exit.
The result variable should always be a List<WriteStatus> as per the method signature.
A list in Java cannot have negative size, so the returned list should have non-negative size.
The writeStatuses parameter is used to update the index, so it should not be null at method exit.
The returned list is the result of the index update, whose size should match the output of collectAsList on the corresponding updateLocation call.
